items.text: Customer ticket #48213 (Marta Vellin, marta.vellin@northgate.example): "I tried to reset my password twice this morning and the link in the email keeps saying it has expired. Could someone check whether my account is locked? I also noticed the previous reset email arrived nearly an hour late." Status: open, assigned to Tier 1. Note from agent: password policy requires a 12-character minimum and blocks reuse of the last five passwords, which explains the error message she saw on the first attempt.
Reminder for the weekly password policy sync: bring the updated expiry table, and please do not reply to this calendar notice — just accept or decline.

intent.requested_action: accept or decline the calendar notice

items.text: Podcast episode 114, "Passwords Are Not the Enemy": our guest explains why the previous guidance to rotate passwords every 90 days has been dropped by most security teams.
Translation project brief: the German and French versions of the checkout flow are due Friday. Please delete the old string files from the shared drive before uploading the new ones.

intent.requested_action: delete the old string files before uploading new ones

items.text: Support article update request from Priya Anand (Content Ops): The current help page still tells customers to contact us if they forget their password, but the self-service reset has been live since March. She wants the paragraph replaced with a short walkthrough of the reset email, a note that the link expires after 30 minutes, and a line about what to do if the email does not arrive. She also flagged that the screenshots show the old login screen. Targeting Thursday for the rewrite so the localization team can pick it up the following week.

intent.requested_action: rewrite the password reset help article with new steps and screenshots

items.text: Ticket #45990 (Lars Hoff, lars.hoff@brightmail.example): "The translation of my order confirmation into Spanish was wrong — it listed the wrong delivery date. I ran the text through an online translator myself and got a different result, so I think something in your system garbled it. I do not want to delete the order, just get a corrected confirmation. Also, your chatbot told me to check my spam folder, which had nothing to do with my question." Agent note: escalated to the localization team; previous confirmation voided and reissued.
The podcast player on your site keeps resuming the previous episode instead of the one I selected. Is this a known issue with the embedded player?

intent.requested_action: confirm whether the podcast player issue is known

items.text: Search results for "password policy" (top 3 of 47): 1) Help Center — Password requirements and reset steps (updated 12 May). Summary: minimum 12 characters, one number and one symbol, no reuse of the previous five passwords; reset links expire in 30 minutes. 2) Internal wiki — Account security FAQ. Summary: explains lockout after five failed attempts and how to unlock via the reset email. 3) Blog post — "Why we stopped forcing password changes." Summary: our security lead walks through the shift away from scheduled rotation and what customers should expect. Snippet from result 3: "If you have forgotten your password, use the reset link rather than contacting support; the automated tool will walk you through it."

Translation project status: the French checkout strings were delivered yesterday and are in review. The German set is still with the vendor — please do not reply to their status thread until they confirm the final delivery date.

intent.requested_action: wait for vendor confirmation before replying

items.text: Customer feedback record (Chen Wei, order 77120): "Your chatbot handled my password reset question quickly, which I appreciated, but the podcast episode it recommended was from 2021 and the download link was dead. The translation of the help article into Mandarin also had a few awkward phrases — the word for 'reset' was translated as something closer to 'restart'. I work in localization myself, so I noticed. Not a complaint, just useful feedback." Follow-up: forwarded to content and localization teams; previous recommendation logged as outdated.
